summary.text: Rebecca Whiting, of Bemidji, is the Libertarian candidate for U.S. Senate. An Army veteran who served as a combat medic, she describes herself as a homeschooling mother and farmer in northern Minnesota. She also ran for this seat in 2024, when she received 1.7% of the vote, and is running on ending U.S. foreign wars and reducing the national debt.

paragraphs.text: Whiting was born in Picayune, Mississippi, and earned a high school diploma from Picayune High School and a bachelor's degree from American Military University in 2010.
She served in the U.S. Army from 2004 to 2007; in a 2024 Ballotpedia survey she said she was a combat medic in Iraq in 2004-05 and 2006-07.
Her career experience includes work as a farmer, baker and small business owner, and she describes herself as a homeschooling mother who raises a large family on a small farm in northern Minnesota.

In KAXE's election guide she listed her employment as a farmer and owner of Dirty Goat Farm & Bakery, and said she is a board member of Bemidji's Natural Choice Farmers Market and chair of the Libertarian Party of Minnesota.
Whiting ran as the Libertarian candidate for U.S. Senate in 2024, finishing third with 55,215 votes (1.7%) behind Amy Klobuchar and Royce White.
